text: Inside, also the network layer, where we perform routing, with this IP layer in it. Okay, now routing will it's a function, a software function that will allow our nodes to select a route and route traffic. Right, so for the source, when we have a routing algorithm and protocol implemented at the network layer, it means that the source knows how to select the route for the packets, data packets that it generates for an intended destination. Okay. Also, for the relay nodes, the intermediate nodes having this routing function implemented at the network layer, means that if they receive packets generated by a source and intended for a final destination, they will know how to forward the packets. Right, how to route the packets farther toward the destination. So if you are a source, the routing function helps you to select the route that your packets need to follow in order to reach the destination. If you are a relay node, so you are not the source, you are not the destination.
